ads.author: Billy Newman
ads.title: Int'l Concepts (by Gottlieb) Cocktail Pinball Machine (Sit Down)
ads.description: This is a really neat and interesting machine. It's lots of fun to play. There are 2 kick-out holes. Once you lock a ball in one, the other functions as a ball swap. (locks the second ball, and the first releases the first ball). There's a separate target to engage multi-ball. It's kinda surprising that a machine of this size has multi-ball, and it brings a lot of character, challenge, and fun to it. There are also 2x in-lane/out-lane on each side. they function as an either an in or an out depending on how you nudge the ball or chance. There is a post between the 2 that can either direct the ball back into the lane, or down the gutter. The music in the game is super '80s and is a perfect fit. Lots of '80s arcade style sound effects as well. The displays are beautiful and are full alpha-numeric. Unfortunately, there are no animations on these displays, unlike some other alpha-numeric pinball machines of the time. Overall, super fun, beautiful lighting design and animations, great sound, semi-challenging game play with good variation built into the play field design. All Bumpers, Lights, Flippers, Scoreboard work GREAT. Overall great condition. Exterior base could use a little touch up paint (see pics) Comes with key. Pick up 1252 Haile Street Camden
